disorder-name.detail: Participants diagnosed with early psychosis via SCID-5 (DSM-5); HCP Early Psychosis cohort. Main text also refers to the patient group as 'individuals with schizophrenia' in one instance, but the overall diagnostic label used for the cohort is 'early psychosis'.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "participants diagnosed with early psychosis (n=118) and control participants (n=55). The dataset's demographic distribution comprises 37% females and 63% males"
disorder-name.location: Cirstian2024.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / Application to a clinical dataset

dataset-of-origin.detail: Human Connectome Project Early Psychosis dataset (Jacobs et al., 2024). Total N=173 with diffusion data (118 patients + 55 controls).
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "we applied these reference models to the HCP early psychosis (HCP-EP) dataset (N=173 with diffusion data -see supplementary table 2 for demographic information)"
dataset-of-origin.location: Cirstian2024.pdf.md: Results / Application to a clinical dataset

age.detail: Patients only (N=118). Mean and SD from Supplementary Table S2. Age range (min/max) not reported.

sex.detail: Patients (N=118). Percentages directly reported in Supplementary Table S2 (M%=62%, F%=38%). N counts estimated from percentages: male_n = round(0.62 × 118) = 73, female_n = 118 − 73 = 45.
